bump_type.description: Version bump type (for instant mode or changeset-pr)

jobs.name: Lint & Format
jobs.if:
github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
github.event_name == 'push' ||
needs.detect-changes.outputs.java-changed == 'true' ||
needs.detect-changes.outputs.pom-changed == 'true' ||
needs.detect-changes.outputs.mjs-changed == 'true' ||
needs.detect-changes.outputs.docs-changed == 'true' ||
needs.detect-changes.outputs.workflow-changed == 'true'

steps.name: Note that coverage was not uploaded
steps.run: echo "::notice::CODECOV_TOKEN is not configured, so coverage was not uploaded"

steps.name: Verify JAR contents
steps.run:
echo "=== JAR contents ==="
jar tf target/*.jar | head -50
echo "..."

steps.name: Check for changesets
steps.run:
CHANGESET_COUNT=$(find .changeset -name "*.md" ! -name "README.md" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "count=$CHANGESET_COUNT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [ "$CHANGESET_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "has_changesets=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Found $CHANGESET_COUNT changeset(s)"
else
  echo "has_changesets=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No changesets found"
fi

steps.name: Build release artifacts
steps.run:
if [ "$SKIP_BUMP" = 'true' ]; then
  RELEASE_SOURCE="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'git worktree remove --force "$RELEASE_SOURCE"' EXIT
  git worktree add --detach "$RELEASE_SOURCE" "refs/tags/v$RELEASE_VERSION"
  ./mvnw -f "$RELEASE_SOURCE/pom.xml" package source:jar javadoc:jar -DskipTests -B
  mkdir -p target
  cp "$RELEASE_SOURCE"/target/*.jar target/
else
  ./mvnw package source:jar javadoc:jar -DskipTests -B
fi

steps.name: Upload release artifacts
steps.run:
TAG="v${{ steps.release.outputs.new_version }}"
gh release upload "$TAG" target/*.jar --clobber

steps.name: Verify published release artifacts
steps.run:
TAG="v${{ steps.release.outputs.new_version }}"
VERIFY_DIRECTORY="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$VERIFY_DIRECTORY"' EXIT
gh release download "$TAG" --pattern '*.jar' --dir "$VERIFY_DIRECTORY"
for artifact in target/*.jar; do
  downloaded="$VERIFY_DIRECTORY/$(basename "$artifact")"
  test -f "$downloaded"
  cmp -- "$artifact" "$downloaded"
done
echo "Verified that every release JAR is downloadable and byte-identical."

steps.name: Create changeset file
steps.run:
DESCRIPTION="$DESCRIPTION_INPUT"
if [ -z "$DESCRIPTION" ]; then
  DESCRIPTION="Manual release"
fi
bun scripts/create-manual-changeset.mjs \
  --bump-type "$BUMP_TYPE" \
  --description "$DESCRIPTION"

jobs.name: Rerun jobs that never got a runner

steps.name: Rerun jobs that no hosted runner acquired
Install OSV-Scanner
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/osv-scanner"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 20 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/osv-scanner/osv-scanner" \
  "https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/releases/download/${OSV_SCANNER_VERSION}/osv-scanner_linux_amd64"
echo "${OSV_SCANNER_SHA256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/osv-scanner/osv-scanner" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/osv-scanner/osv-scanner"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/osv-scanner" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Audit Maven build plugins (all severities)
steps.run:
node --test experiments/maven-plugin-audit.test.mjs
./mvnw dependency:list dependency:resolve-plugins -Prelease -DexcludeArtifactIds=maven-site-plugin -DoutputFile=target/resolved-artifacts.txt -DappendOutput=true -B -ntp
node scripts/audit-maven-plugins.mjs pom.xml target/resolved-artifacts.txt
